teams.title: Guild War

play.text: Build one strong team. It attacks strongholds and it is also your defense team.
Your other two teams are 1–2 characters each, used only to grab free tiles.
Common mistake: three medium teams that all attack. That wastes attacks.
Stronghold that never seems to die? Test a 1–2 character attack before you use a full team.

rows.label: Strong team · free-to-play
why: Every No Org skill makes Nutcracker attack again for free, so four No Org units hit over and over.
All free except Nutcracker (Wish Rebate, days 1–7). No Nutcracker? Use your best SSR.
From day 43, put Kiyoko in the back-up slot: +40% stats and a death save for every ally, in Stronghold Takeover only.
Source: research notes of October 26, 2026, section A6.

rows.label: Strong team · meta (Aogiri)
why: Black Rabbit is DST, so he beats every attribute. Miza strips shields every turn.
Line-up order: Naki last, then Black Rabbit, then Yakumo [Natsu Matsuri].
Yakumo [Natsu Matsuri] was weakened on October 14. Black Rabbit and Miza are banned in the Global Pinnacle Championship.
Source: research notes of October 26, 2026, section A6.

more: Guild tip: attacking a free tile with any team claims it, so a strong team spent there is a wasted attack.
Guild tip example: the opponent pushes and takes a tile; your one-character team on the free tile next to it grabs it.
Only the top 8 organizations in the Weekly Challenge can enter. The check is Saturday 10:00.
Each player brings 3 teams. You get 10 attack charges, plus 1 every 20 minutes. Spend them.

Lost HP comes back only slowly between fights (a win in a Hospital's area refunds 25% of the HP lost). Healing can't raise HP above the HP a unit started the fight with. Whether this hits defenders, attackers or both is unconfirmed. Either way, burst wins attacks.
A Police Station flips its whole area when you take it: the best free tile to grab.

Tower breakers to test on a stronghold that won't die: Shu [Mr.MM] or Toka [Anteiku] with Yakumo [Jason]. Shu needs 1★ for his damage cut and 3★ for his shield; Toka needs 1★ for lifesteal and 3★ for her death save. Meta: Black Rabbit with Miza or Naki [1.5th Anniversary]. (unconfirmed)
Practice in Takeover Simulation (Organization menu) before Saturday. (creator tip)
If the game refuses a 1-character team, make your tile team from your 5 weakest units.
Buy extra attack charges before you pay for revives: each of the first 9 charges costs less than one revive after the 5th.
NPC defenders switch off your passives for 1–2 turns. Bring skill burst.

Anteiku (Toka [Maid Costume], Yoshimura [Readiness], Toka [June Bride], Hinami [Hina Matsuri]; back-up Akira [June Bride]) was the October 19 article's best defense team. Creators now call Anteiku weaker. (creator tip)

bosses.text: Bring attributes that beat the boss: STR beats SKL, SKL beats SPD, SPD beats STR.
Merge skill cards to Lv3 before you cast.
Stun and full Weak stop counters; Disruption does not.

spend.text: Never start a banner you can't finish: pity doesn't carry over.
Limited banners guarantee the unit at 300 pulls: bank 90,000 Diamonds first.
Diamond Spring: take the 48-hour option when you'll be away a day.

progression.text: Level only your main team (5–6 units, back-up included).
A second copy (1★) is the best upgrade: it unlocks the second passive.
3★ and 4★ add more passives; 6★ upgrades the active skill.
Put Limit Crystals into your main carry.
